systems.tiers: the state's administrative network, serving public bodies generally; the statute gives INFOSI technical support duties to ministerial departments and provincial governments and names no municipal office on the network

note: An organic statute of 31 May 2021 giving INFOSI the running of the state's private network and data centre, with provincial departments; it is a law, names no local government office as connected, and the held text is cut off at Article 22.
